newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Transportation chief Platt to join NYS Thuway.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Transportation chief Platt to join NYS Thuway.

text.p: John Platt, the chief of staff for the Ohio Department of Transportation, said Wednesday he will resign his post October 11 to join the New York State Thruway Authority as executive director.
Platt, 53, joined the Ohio Department of Transportation in 1991 as the assistant director of transportation modes.
He became chief of staff for the department in 1995.
